propositions: fsck.py is at the 800-line hard cap and cannot accept any new changes, blocking bug fixes and improvements
the file fuses four independent concerns (per-ticket store walk, tracker-level health, JSON report shaping, CLI driver) that grow monotonically with each new check added
the decomposition separates concerns along existing call-graph seams: enumeration+validators to fsck_scan.py, tracker health to fsck_tracker_health.py, command driver+report shaping remain in fsck.py
complexity-ratchet entries must be decomposed under C901 threshold rather than moved wholesale to avoid triggering the --lock gate that forbids new baseline keys
external callers of fsck module symbols are preserved via re-exports; no changes required in gitutil.py, fsck_recover.py, tracker_maintenance.py, or test files
the refactor is behaviour-preserving: identical output, exit codes, and findings; verified by byte-identical fsck_cli JSON output before and after
